title: LexicalFieldBank file
description: One JSON file under assets/content/<module>/verbal_boxes/lexical_fields/. Holds the French lexical fields the word_boxes generator draws from (Boîte à mots, spec §2.4-I, US-030/US-085). Dart: LexicalFieldBank, LexicalField, LexicalTrap.

LexicalField.description: A semantic category and the words that belong to it. A word must belong to exactly one field among any set of fields the generator may mix in one series (validator check, US-014).

name.description: Name of the field, shown in explanations only (in the real test boxes are labelled by their first word).

difficulty.description: How obvious the category is: 1 = animals, 5 = abstract or specialised fields.

tags.description: verbal.boxes plus a theme tag, e.g. verbal.boxes.everyday / verbal.boxes.aviation.

words.description: Unambiguous members of the field, 15-25 recommended. Lowercase, singular, no article.

traps.description: Words that DO belong to this field but look like they belong to another (near misses). Drawn according to WordBoxesParams.trapRatio.

incompatibleWith.description: Fields that must never share a series with this one because some words would fit both (e.g. 'fruits' and 'desserts').

trapFor.description: Id of the field a hurried candidate would wrongly pick for this word.
